note: Lab H22 (user hint 9, 2026-10-03): series of 20-30 min listen-and-repeat videos titled with the words of the '100 Daily Use English Phrases | Listen and Repeat Practice' cluster. Per phrase: phrase, pause, phrase again, pause; every tenth phrase = 'say this instead' (a stronger phrase from our approved Shorts); after each part all ten again.

beats.speech: One hundred English phrases for daily use. Listen and repeat. You will hear each phrase, and then you say it out loud in the pause. Then you hear it again, and you say it again. Every tenth phrase is a stronger way to say something simple. You don't need to look at the screen. Let's start.
